key.name: show-icon
key.description: Display the custom Codex Usage Monitor icon in the panel.

key.name: panel-gauge
key.description: Which usage gauge to draw in the panel: a circular ring, a horizontal bar, or none.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the usage percentage number in the panel.

key.name: show-tier
key.description: Display the subscription tier label (e.g. TEAM, PLUS, PRO) in the panel, after the Codex icon.

key.name: show-tier-icon
key.description: Display the icon of the subscription tier in the panel, after the Codex icon.

key.name: show-reset
key.description: Display, in the panel, the time left before each window shown there (see panel-windows) resets.

key.name: show-profile-chip
key.description: Display a short two-letter tag before each profile's gauge in the panel, to tell profiles apart. Only ever shown when more than one profile is configured.

key.name: panel-window
key.description: Deprecated: superseded by panel-windows, which can hold several selectors.

key.name: panel-windows
key.description: Which usage windows the panel shows, one gauge (ring/bar, percentage) per window, tagged "5h"/"7d"/model name when more than one is shown. Accepted selectors: five-hour, seven-day, scoped, max, worst.

key.name: panel-divider
key.description: Text placed between the groups of gauges when the panel shows more than one window (see panel-windows), e.g. "·". Exactly "|" draws a thin vertical line; blank leaves a plain gap.

key.name: panel-lead-divider
key.description: Text placed between the leading elements (Codex icon, profile tag, tier icon and label) and the gauges, and between profiles. Exactly "|" draws a thin vertical line; blank shows no divider.

key.name: ui-style
key.description: JSON object of the style values changed from their defaults under "Top-Bar UI" and "Popup UI" in preferences.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator sits in: left, center, or right.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items in its panel box.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Shortcut to open the usage popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the usage dropdown.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to poll for updated usage.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of {id, label, configDir} objects, one per profile (a directory such as ~/.codex holding credentials).

key.name: profiles-initialized
key.summary: Whether the profile list has been seeded
key.description: Set once auto-detection has populated "profiles" for the first time.

key.name: profile-tokens
key.description: JSON object mapping a profile id to its in-app sign-in tokens ({accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt}).

key.name: access-token
key.description: Access token from in-app sign-in.

key.name: refresh-token
key.description: Refresh token from in-app sign-in.

key.name: expires-at
key.description: Millisecond timestamp when the access token expires.
